company.name: Dollar Shave Club
company.shortDescription: DSC is a lifestyle brand and e-commerce company that delivers razors and other personal grooming products to customers by mail.
company.description:
Dollar Shave Club is a lifestyle brand and e-commerce company that invents and delivers smart, affordable products to make lives easier. Through an exclusive R&D process that includes botanicals and chemists, the company makes all its own products at affordable prices.

Dollar Shave Club was founded in 2012 and is based in Santa Monica, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Dollar Shave Club is researching and developing shaving razor systems, as described in titles such as 'Razor cartridge' and 'Razor exposure.' The abstracts detail systems with razor handles that dock with cartridges using a single hook and spring-mounted pushrod, as well as cartridges featuring unitary frames with angled joints and multiple guards. These efforts focus on improving the design and functionality of razor handles and cartridges for personal grooming.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $90,700,000, or 55.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,237,663 to $590,700,000, a 112.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 74 (-15 over 90 days) and market heat at 25 (+15).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
